title: Show HN: Rmux – A programmable terminal multiplexer with a Playwright-style SDK
summary: Rmux is a terminal multiplexer rebuilt from scratch in Rust that combines tmux compatibility with a programmable async SDK. It enables Playwright-style automation for terminals, replacing fragile grep-and-sleep scripts with structured snapshots, stable pane IDs, and locator-style waits.
problem_solved: Eliminates fragile terminal automation that relies on grep, sleeps, and output scraping by providing structured APIs and reliable synchronization primitives.
why_valuable: It brings modern web automation patterns (like Playwright) to terminal multiplexing, making CLI automation reliable and programmatic while maintaining backward compatibility with existing tmux workflows.
